title: Outstanding Oven Roasted Vietnamese Pork Tagine
description: A rich and juicy one-pot Vietnamese dish featuring yogurt and tempering chocolate, made keto-friendly in a ceramic tagine vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine yogurt, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger, and blend until smooth.
In a large ceramic tagine, combine the blended yogurt mixture, pork shoulder, tempering chocolate, star anise, black pepper, and salt.
Cover the tagine with a lid and roast in the preheated oven for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the pork shoulder into thick slices and serve with the juices from the tagine.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as cilantro or basil, if desired.
